name: defining-minimum-viable-product

method.focus: identify the smallest end-to-end product that tests the product thesis rather than a pile of disconnected features
steps: State the product thesis and riskiest causal assumption.
Map the single critical user journey that can falsify the thesis.
Include only capabilities required to complete and measure that journey.
Define operational, security, accessibility, and recovery minimums that cannot be deferred.
Move every other capability to a later hypothesis with an explicit trigger for reconsideration.
verification: Does the MVP deliver user value end to end?
Can it test the riskiest assumption?
Are reliability and security basics treated as scope, not polish?
Can every included feature name the thesis dependency it serves?
traps: building infrastructure without a user loop

procedure: Read confirmed evidence, selected concept, and unresolved assumptions.

rules: The output directly and completely performs defining minimum viable product within its declared boundary.
Does the MVP deliver user value end to end?
Can it test the riskiest assumption?
Are reliability and security basics treated as scope, not polish?
Can every included feature name the thesis dependency it serves?
Every material claim is traceable to an input, decision, executable check, or evidence item.
Required fields are complete and machine-readable.
The producing agent is not the approving reviewer.
Open uncertainty and residual risk are explicit; critical findings are never hidden by an aggregate score.
gate.passCondition: All mandatory rules pass, evidence targets the current artifact hash, and no unresolved critical finding applies.

handoff.stopWhen: Output contract is satisfied, a blocker is recorded, or a material human decision is required.

failureModes: producing prose without the contracted artifact
expanding scope without a decision record
building infrastructure without a user loop
description: Use when defining minimum viable product is required during product work, especially when the result must be traceable, independently reviewable, and safe to hand to another agent.
